_readme: Per-Actor audit index, built cycle 815 to replace expensive ad hoc grepping through STATUS_ARCHIVE.md/queue_archive.md (see LEARNINGS.md cycle 811 + cycle 814's dead-end search). Fields are the LAST cycle number a given audit type was run, or null if never done / not yet backfilled. Update this file in the SAME cycle you run any of these audit types on an Actor -- add/replace the relevant field with the current cycle number and a one-line note. Keys: varied_test (plain filter-combo rotation), enum_audit (checked enum/vocabulary fields for structurally-dead values), unreachable_remedy (checked that a zero-row message's suggested fix is actually reachable), competitor_audit (compared price/features against the named competitor). Dates below are backfilled from cycles 797-814's own summaries (already read this session, not fresh archaeology) -- treat gaps (nulls) as real unknowns, not omissions.

ats-jobs-scraper.note: cycle 817: provider-by-provider live reachability pass, all 7 ATSes (greenhouse/ashby/lever/recruitee/workable/smartrecruiters/workday) hit directly against their real default-company boards. All 200s, all field shapes match code expectations exactly. No structural drift, no bugs. cycle 818: competitor_audit via apify-admin store 'ats jobs scraper'/'greenhouse jobs' -- real leader by user count is automation-lab/multi-ats-jobs-scraper (161 users, FREE tier $0.00115/job + $0.005 one-time start) and webdata_labs/greenhouse-lever-ashby-jobs-scraper (65 users, $0.001/job flat, no start fee, only 4 platforms vs our 7). Our FREE tier was $0.0015/job, 30-50% above both. Feature-wise we already lead on breadth (7 ATS platforms vs their 4-5), so no feature gap -- price was the real gap. Cut FREE tier $0.0015->$0.001 (matches webdata_labs, ~13% below automation-lab), scaled BRONZE/SILVER/GOLD+ tiers proportionally (0.00085/0.00075/0.0007), still ~7x over the ~$0.0001/item HTTP-only compute floor. Verified live via API pull post-publish, check-pricing 0 drift, check-charges 24/24 clean.
